marta: quick heads-up — acadia13b (int4) canary showing intermittent OOMs and elevated prefetch alloc churn on long-conditioning prompts (>1200 tokens). saw a few 5xx rejects this morning. anyone free to triage? :thinking:

li: paste a tiny log if you have one please

marta: snippet:```
2026-06-12T06:22:10Z worker-4 ERROR cudaMalloc failed: out of memory	alloc_chunk=1.0MB	free_slots=2	max_new_tokens=768	microbatch=6	prefetch=on
callstack: serve->kv_prefetch->alloc_chunk
```

owen: sounds like fragmentation. int4 cuts model weights but increases number of tiny per-step buffers. low-effort mitigations: drop model default max_new_tokens 768->320, set microbatch.soft_cap=4, lower kv_evict_threshold 0.6->0.55. also try enabling slot_compactor on one canary worker to see if freelist coalescing helps.

sasha: also ran a quick sweep — int4 has a small quality dip on our reasoning-suite (exact: ACC -2.1 pts vs fp16) when long generations allowed. command: `./evals/run_quality.py --model acadia13b --quant int4 --suite reasoning-long --seed 11`

benchmark-bot: eval artifacts uploaded: gs://redwood-evals/acadia13b/1849990000/int4_vs_fp16/report.html (summary: ACC -2.1, length-mismatches concentrated when max_new_tokens>=512)

li: agree with mitigations. prefer conservative defaults + routing rather than revert. operational rule: route requests with ctx_estimate>1200 to acadia13b-int8. pseudoconfig: `routes: - match: ctx>1200 -> model: acadia13b-int8`

owen: i'll flip slot_compactor=on for canary-2 and leave canary-3 as control; will collect memory histograms for 30m. patch defaults and open PR for rollout.

sasha: i'll run the full eval sweep (int4/int8/fp16) and add sample diffs to the onboarding checklist. if quality delta >2.5 pts on critical suites we keep routing to int8 for long-chat.

pagerduty: paging policy active: page on >1% 5xx over 5m for acadia13b-int4.

marta: plan recap: (1) owen to patch canary defaults (max_new_tokens=320, microbatch.soft_cap=4, kv_evict_threshold=0.55) and enable slot_compactor on one worker (ETA 45m), (2) sasha to finish eval sweeps and post artifacts (ETA 2h), (3) li to add route rule for long contexts to int8 on canary routing (ETA 1h). update this thread with traces, histograms, and eval links. if anything degrades we rollback. :thumbsup:
